title: Output after a zero in a bit string
statement: For every natural number $j$ and every finite Boolean string $l$, the transducer that emits one zero on each bit after it has read a zero, and emits nothing before then, produces a string of $|l|$ zeros on the concatenation of $j$ ones, a zero, and $l$.
